title: Nutrition for Athletes: A practical guide to eating for health and performance
claims: 基于 2010 年洛桑 IOC 营养共识会议编写，2012 年 4 月由 Ron Maughan 与 Louise Burke 修订。

For events longer than 60 minutes, the booklet advises using the pre-event meal to top up carbohydrate; pre-event meals that enhance performance in longer events generally provide 1–4 g/kg body mass, and an intake below 1 g/kg in the 1–6 h before exercise followed by no carbohydrate during exercise is described as a mistake.
For ultra-endurance exercise lasting more than about 2.5–3 hours, carbohydrate intake can reach up to 90 g/hour and should be practised in training.
